fsm_hints.trigger: Host drives all strobes; device never initiates. R/B_n is the only device-driven async signal.
fsm_hints.rule: Status bit 6 (RDY) reflects per-LUN ready state; R/B_n is wired-OR of LUN busy.
fsm_hints.abort: Reset (FFh) universal abort; Synchronous Reset (FCh) preserves interface; Reset LUN (FAh) per-LUN.

anti_deadlock_rule: Host shall not issue a new command to a LUN while RDY=0, except Read Status (70h), Read Status Enhanced (78h), Reset (FFh), Synchronous Reset (FCh), Reset LUN (FAh).
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on, target requires Reset (FFh) before any commands. Defaults to SDR data interface, timing mode 0. WP_n sampled during reset.

default_ready_state_recommendation.RE_n_idle: HIGH (SDR family; same default in NV-DDR family).
default_ready_state_recommendation.DQS_idle: Driven HIGH by host during NV-DDR2/3 Idle if ODT is enabled (otherwise don't-care).
default_ready_state_recommendation.R_B_n_idle: HIGH via external pull-up; LOW only when at least one LUN is busy.
default_ready_state_recommendation.WP_n_idle: LOW = write-protect engaged; HIGH = Program/Erase enabled.

configurations.name: NV-DDR mode
configurations.description: Set Features (01h Timing Mode); CLK on WE_n pin; bidirectional DQS.

configurations.name: NV-DDR2 mode
configurations.description: Set Features (01h + 02h NV-DDR2/3 Config); WE_n cmd/addr; differential DQS.

configurations.name: NV-DDR3 mode
configurations.description: Set Features (01h + 02h); differential DQS and RE_t/RE_c; DCC/DQ training.

timing_dependency_rule: All commands via CLE+WE_n (cmd) and ALE+WE_n (addr). Read data: SDR — falling RE_n; NV-DDR — DQS edges on both polarities. Write data: SDR — rising WE_n; NV-DDR — DQS edges. Section 4.17 defines tCCS / tWHR / tWB / tRR / tFEAT per data interface.
